verdict_text: YES. The script loads all three checkpoints, verifies identical key sets and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor against the base before any merging (clause 1), computes each of the 64 MLP tensors in float32 from the unmodified base plus both scaled task vectors and casts back to the base float16 dtype (clause 2), copies all other tensors from the base unchanged with unchanged names (clause 3), and asserts `merged == 64` and `len(out) == 244` before writing a single `model.safetensors` under the output directory (clause 4 and the required checks). The regex `fullmatch` selects exactly the four MLP tensor names per layer and nothing else.
